about: Portable numeric reference for the exact source clip (Musk post 2110913107094606330, media 2110913027490934784). Extracted from the Codex motion-match review (motion-reference.json). Image references are basenames inside the motion-match directory; pass that directory to build_scene.py with --reference-dir. Coordinates are approximate manual screen-space anchors in the 1920x1080 source (origin top-left, +y down), not calibrated 3D trajectory, speed, height or angles.

shots.camera: wide fixed-looking camera, parked lineup centered, chained foreground post at right
shots.observed_action: at far right a cloud develops, then light car becomes visible already airborne; clean wheel liftoff obscured
shots.replay_relation: initial wide approach; cuts into close view

shots.camera: close camera above/behind a foreground car roof and windshield; background nearly black
shots.observed_action: airborne coupe crosses from image right to left above foreground vehicle; side then black canopy then underside visible as roll advances
shots.replay_relation: continuous action in a new angle, not independent second flight

shots.camera: close camera behind tall central truck cab; angular pickup at left; cab occludes center
shots.observed_action: airborne car reappears high, moves toward image right; body rolls through canopy/underside/side views, then descends behind right foreground/crop/cloud
shots.replay_relation: continuation/alternate angle; left/right screen direction reversal comes from camera change

shots.camera: return to shot A wide camera and matching static lineup composition
shots.observed_action: fuller slow replay-like view: emergence from right cloud, rise and right-to-left airborne roll above lineup, near-level descent at left, expanding cloud; touchdown not visible
shots.replay_relation: the approach and roll repeat after returning to earlier wide composition; do not portray this as a second independent stunt

tracking_basis: manual approximate screen-space vehicle box; excludes plumes; allow about 20-30 source pixels uncertainty; not physical position or 3D pose angles

occlusion_and_contact.takeoff: clean wheels-off-ground time not observed; far-right cloud masks origin; first visible poses are already airborne
occlusion_and_contact.ground_contact: not visually resolved; vehicle exits/crops at left in wide view and is cloud/foreground occluded in close view
occlusion_and_contact.overhead_lines: visible environmental lines; attachment and load-bearing role unconfirmed
